approaches_tried.approach: Communicate the derived issued number from the jq allocation prefix back to bash via a SECOND, independent jq probe (alloc_issued_number) computed against the SAME pre-transform inputs, rather than trying to extract it out of the jq program's own $NAME binding
approaches_tried.reason: pnum_next_free is a pure function of (state, archive) at a fixed point in time; recomputing it bash-side with the identical archive binding (JQ_ARGS) is deterministic and avoids any plumbing through the jq program's output channel. Verified byte-identical to the number the caller's filter actually received, across every hand-built fixture.
